snippet.title: RollerCoaster Tycoon Wonderworks - Official Early Access Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Wonderworks Worldwide corporation, where we put the wonder to work for you. We’re offering a rare opportunity to get in on the ground floor of an all-new RollerCoaster Tycoon empire.

In this Early Access edition, self-starter tycoons are invited to test their design and business strategy skills in two new theme parks across the globe. It’s your one-of-a-kind chance to help the board hone additional features and mayhem. Customize your theme park to improve your guests’ experiences and maximize profits for your corporate overlords.

Wishlist Now: https://link.atari.com/RCTWW

Tycoons now have a dedicated Discord server! Talk tips, share builds and embrace the chaos: https://link.atari.com/RCTDiscord


Join the Atari Discord: https://link.atari.com/atariclubdiscord
